summary.text: At Sea Gate on Zendikar, Gideon Jura leads the Zendikari army to retake the city from the Eldrazi, with Nissa Revane returning with the world's elementals and Jace Beleren proposing a hedron trap for the titan Ulamog.
The trap works at first, but the demon Ob Nixilis knocks a hedron out of alignment to free Ulamog, and Kozilek rises from the bay, so the army collapses and Sea Gate falls.

With the army gone and two titans creeping across the land, Gideon, Nissa, Jace and Chandra Nalaar swear an oath to keep watch against threats to the Multiverse, and Jace says they must pull the titans fully into the physical world to kill them.
